title: Retrofitting a walking-beam bar furnace: length measurement, centring, guidance and discharge limits
summary: A bar-heating walking-beam furnace retrofit adds inlet length measurement and centring, while levelling the walking beams and adding side guides and a discharge limit. These address entry position, movement inside the furnace and the discharge boundary respectively. Check them along the route of an individual bar.
